Relationship evidence and context
Reported in a specified context: RAF (BRAF, CRAF) → MEK1/2

The study reported a Raf-1–Mek1 complex and Mek1 activation associated with serine phosphorylation after coexpression with Raf-1.

Context: Recombinant Raf-1 (CRAF) and Mek1 proteins produced in Sf9 insect cells; association and phosphorylation experiments.

This experiment concerns CRAF and MEK1 in a recombinant system. It does not establish the same behaviour for every RAF isoform or show patient benefit from a drug combination.

Huang et al., PNAS 1993 (primary experiment)

Checked 2026-11-08
